'''Lua'wan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who held the rank of [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] of the prison in which [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was kept following her arrest in [[44 ABY]].
